name: Tanzania

fees.name: Ordinary (Single Entry) e-Visa
fees.notes: As of Jan 2025, visa on arrival was abolished; all visitors must apply via the official e-visa portal visa.immigration.go.tz before arrival. Official notice warns any invoice above 50 USD for the Ordinary Visa indicates use of an unauthorised agent.

fees.name: Multiple Entry Visa
fees.applies: eligible nationalities (also standard tourism visa for US citizens)

fees.name: Visa on Arrival
fees.notes: Visa on arrival was abolished as of January 2025; all applicants must now obtain an e-visa online prior to travel.

reciprocity_variations.note: US citizens are required to apply for the Multiple Entry Visa (100 USD, valid 12 months) for holiday/tourism purposes rather than the 50 USD single-entry Ordinary Visa, per the Tanzania Embassy in Washington D.C.

free_visa_notes: A 'Gratis Visa' (free) category exists on the official fee schedule for specific exempted cases (e.g. diplomatic/reciprocal arrangements), but standard tourist/business travel requires a paid e-visa for virtually all nationalities. No official reciprocity fee breakdown by nationality (India, UK, China, Nigeria, Pakistan, Philippines, Bangladesh, Russia, Canada) was found beyond the US-specific rate; these likely pay the standard 50 USD Ordinary Visa fee, but this was not independently confirmed on an official nationality-by-nationality schedule, hence amounts for those nationalities are not separately listed.
